checks.name: A1: every target reports a fitted baseline against its documented naive comparator, measured out of time
A1: no fold's model was fitted on rows it was then scored on
A1: every feature in every snapshot was public by its own cutoff
A2: observed facts, estimates and missing data are three distinct classes on every card, and no estimate wears the observed class
A3: the source-tier ablation reports, per target, whether document and institutional enrichment adds value over structured sources alone
A4: every target and tier carries a calibration and error report measured out of time, with its denominators
A5 / negative rule: no resident-facing legal conclusion is emitted anywhere, and the card stays internal
negative rule: the targets are never collapsed into one project-risk score
the ordinal ladder covers every state the frozen ontology defines
this card's own warehouse test suite stays green
